# Abacus Global Management to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on Thursday, November 5, 2026


October 15, 2026 8:00am EDT


ORLANDO, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Abacus Global Management, Inc. (NYSE: ABX), a financial services company specializing in alternative asset management, with a focus on longevity-based assets and personalized financial planning, today announced it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Thursday, November 5, 2026.


Abacus will hold a conference call to discuss the financial results at 5:00 pm Eastern Time on November 5, 2026. A live webcast of the conference call will be available on Abacus’ investor relations website at[ir.abacusgm.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=o4YgjjEErQVxm2QjDImfHmxyLjL2bYGTDHVD4z_-XXcY2Dp14wfeOvzY8jRfTvpYwdRUzkQqIKQ_y8z2W6S3kaEnQj7o6BGXTPQ4j5j9ZZU=) . The dial-in number for the conference call is (833) 309-3473 (toll-free) or (785) 838-9251 (International) and participants must enter Conference ID “ABACUS” when joining. Please dial the number 10 minutes prior to the scheduled start time.


A webcast replay of the call will be available[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=lFhVwNwWL8kXqdb8ZH2Lp8P7fDQxxBkVBOPSzdkaTRJKT24IJHorRkssiCK0elJ7BgV2yAr4_geHPHu24OzkhOi6AjceLe8VX9qyd7fJOigvpCQomkhwxG3Dy6E7CKJp) for one year following the call.


**About Abacus**


Abacus Global Management (NYSE: ABX) is a financial services company specializing in alternative asset management, data-driven wealth solutions, technology innovation, and institutional services. With a focus on longevity-based assets and personalized financial planning, Abacus leverages proprietary data analytics and decades of industry expertise to deliver innovative solutions that optimize financial outcomes for individuals and institutions worldwide.


For more information, please visit[www.abacusgm.com](http://www.abacusgm.com/) .
